statement_map.email_excerpt: Leads were coming in from your form, but the autoresponder email was not being sent to them.

Following our guidance, you switched on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, and after a test form from another email you confirmed the email arrived and the autoresponder is now working.
Emails can sometimes go to spam, so it is a good idea to verify your sender domain, which you can do in Settings, in the email domain section.
Verify your sender domain in the email domain section of Settings (you mentioned you'd do this the morning after our call).
